shift: labels in train and val are shifted

data_issues: The y labels in train and val are shifted by one class compared with the stimulus log: y = (movie_time_s - 101) mod 8, so 101 s is labelled 0 instead of 1 and 100 s is labelled 7 instead of 0. Every labeled trial (56/56) is off by one. I trained on the correct labels from movie_time_s, i.e. class = movie_time_s - 100.
